messages.content: You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aden casts Shattering Spree, replicating it twice. Nico controls Chalice of the Void with 1 charge counter. What happens?

The original Shattering Spree is countered, the two copies resolve as normal. Replicate and Chalice of the Void both trigger when the spell is cast. (702.56a) Since the Chalice of the Void trigger is controlled by the player last in turn order, it will resolve first, countering Shattering Spree. Then Shattering Spree's trigger resolves and creates two copies of Shattering Spree. (113.7a, 608.2h) The copies are not cast, so they don't trigger Chalice of the Void. (707.10)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Angelica casts Roar of the Wurm. In response, Nicholas casts Gather Specimens. In response, Angelica casts Crafty Cutpurse. Who gets the token?

Angelica does. There is only one replacement effect applying to the original event, (Gather Specimens's) so it's applied. That causes Crafty Cutpurse's effect to become applicable (616.2), and the token goes back to being created under Angelica's control. Gather Specimens won't apply again. (614.5) It doesn't matter that Crafty Cutpurse applies to the creation of the tokens while Crafty Cutpurse applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event. (701.7)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Aitana controls Stonybrook Schoolmaster, a Plains, and 2 Forests. Can they cast Venerated Loxodon by tapping the 3 lands, the Stonybrook Schoolmaster, and the token created by Stonybrook Schoolmaster?
No. The cost to cast Venerated Loxodon must be paid as it's cast. (601.2f, 702.51a) The token is only created when the trigger resolves, after the Venerated Loxodon has been cast. (603.3, 117.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Addison casts Chaos Warp targeting Noelle's commander. Noelle chooses to put it into the command zone instead of the library. Is Noelle's library shuffled? Do them reveal the card of their library and put it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card?

Noelle does shuffle their library. (701.24c)

Noelle does reveal the top card. Chaos Warp doesn't care where the target moves to as it resolves, it simply instructs Noelle to do so.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn casts Necromentia while Noor controls Crystal Barricade. What happens as it resolves?
This can't happen as described. There are no legal targets for Necromentia, so Autumn cannot cast it. (601.2, 601.2c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alden controls a Crystalline Nautilus. Alden casts Restoration Angel. Will Crystalline Nautilus be sacrificed?

Yes. Restoration Angel's ability goes on the stack when it enters the battlefield, and part of putting the ability on the stack involves choosing legal targets for the ability. (603.3, 601.2c) Even if Alden has no intention of exiling Crystalline Nautilus, they don't make that decision until the ability starts resolving. (608.2d, 603.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari controls a manifested Progenitus. They attacks with the manifested Progenitus and Nixon blocks with a Carnage Tyrant. What zone does the Progenitus move to?

The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event they're modifying in order to apply to it. (614.4) Immediately before the Progenitus died it had no abilities, and the replacement effect didn't exist.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Avery controls Ephara, God of the Polis, and then casts Opalescence. Their devotion to white is 2. Is Ephara, God of the Polis a creature? If so, what is its power and toughness?

Ephara, God of the Polis is a creature with power and toughness equal to its mana value.

In the type layer, there are 2 effects that impact Ephara, God of the Polis's type. (613.1d) They are applied in timestamp order (613.7), so first Ephara, God of the Polis's effect causes Ephara, God of the Polis to not be a creature, then Opalescence's ability causes Ephara, God of the Polis to become a creature.

In the power/toughness setting layer, Opalescence's effect sets Ephara, God of the Polis's power and toughness equal to its mana value. (613.4b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Adelaide controls Jace's Sanctum and wants to cast Beacon Bolt from their graveyard. How much does the Beacon Bolt cost to cast?
{U}{R}. Jace's Sanctum's effect applies to any spell Adelaide casts, regardless of what zone it's being cast from. It can only reduce the spell's cost by {1}, not any colored mana. (118.7a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ares controls Anointed Procession and casts Call of the Conclave. In response, Nyla casts Gather Specimens. Who creates how many tokens?

Nyla creates 2 tokens. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the same event. Anointed Procession is trying to apply to the creation of the tokens, while Gather Specimens is trying to apply to them entering the battlefield. Entering the battlefield is a part of creating the tokens (701.7a), so Anointed Procession's effect must be applied first, followed by Gather Specimens. (616.1g)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alonso controls a tapped Skyshroud Elf and Ashnod's Altar. Can they cast Relentless Raptor?

No. Alonso can activate Skyshroud Elf's second ability and use Ashnod's Altar to pay for it, but by the time they have the opportunity to activate its ability an additional time, Skyshroud Elf is no longer on the battlefield. (605.3c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Abraham controls Uphill Battle and casts Merfolk of the Pearl Trident. Before that resolves, Nico casts Gather Specimens. Will Merfolk of the Pearl Trident enter the battlefield tapped?
No. Merfolk of the Pearl Trident was not played by Nico. (701.18b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Natalee controls Tasseled Dromedary. Aspen casts Flickerwisp and targets Tasseled Dromedary with its triggered ability. At the beginning of Aspen's end step, Aspen puts Flickerwisp's delayed trigger onto the stack. In response, Natalee casts Voidslime targeting the trigger. What happens to Tasseled Dromedary?

Tasseled Dromedary will stay in exile indefinitely. When Flickerwisp's ability resolved, it created a delayed trigger to return Tasseled Dromedary to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step. This delayed trigger only triggers once, regardless of whether it resolves or not. (603.7b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Niko controls a Melira, Sylvok Outcast. Ainsley activates Inkmoth Nexus to turn it into a creature and attacks Niko with it. Niko doesn't block. What happens during the combat damage step?

Melira, Sylvok Outcast's effect makes Inkmoth Nexus lose infect and Inkmoth Nexus's ability gives it infect. The effects are applied in timestamp order (613.3), so Inkmoth Nexus has infect. When damage is dealt, Niko can't get a poison counter, so nothing happens. (101.3)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ariel controls Levitating Statue, Life and Limb, March of the Machines, and Conspiracy naming "Saproling", that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Levitating Statue?

It's a 2/2 colorless Artifact Creature - Saproling.

In layer 4, Life and Limb's effect is not dependent on March of the Machines or Conspiracy (613.8a), so Life and Limb is applied first, then March of the Machines, then Conspiracy. Since Life and Limb didn't apply to Levitating Statue in layer 4, it doesn't apply to it in later layers either. (613.6)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aubrey unmorphes Gift of Doom. Can Aubrey attach it to Darkwatch Elves?
No. Protection means that Darkwatch Elves can't be enchanted by Auras with the stated quality (702.16c), which means it's illegal to attach it. (303.4b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Noe has Erebos's Titan in their graveyard. Ariel controls Kess, Dissident Mage and wants to cast Beat a Path from their graveyard. Can they cast Beat a Path this way? If so, will Erebos's Titan's triggered ability trigger?

Yes, Ariel can cast Beat a Path and Erebos's Titan's ability will trigger.

When determining if an adventurer card can be cast as an Adventure, only the card's alternative characteristics are considered. (601.3e/715.3a) Since Beat a Path is an instant or sorcery, Kess, Dissident Mage allows it to be cast from the graveyard.

Since it's a creature card while in the graveyard (715.4), Erebos's Titan triggers when it leaves the graveyard.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari controls 3 artifacts and casts Rusted Relic. Nikolas controls Uphill Battle. Does Rusted Relic enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?

Tapped. To determine what replacement effects apply to a permanent as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. (614.12) On the battlefield Rusted Relic would be a creature, so Uphill Battle's effect will apply to it.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Atticus controls a Phantasmal Image that's a copy of Squire. There are no creatures other than Phantasmal Image on the battlefield. Atticus casts Jeskai Barricade. Do they have to sacrifice Phantasmal Image?
Yes. Choices such as "you may do [thing]" are made upon resolution. (608.2d) Atticus still has to choose a legal target for Jeskai Barricade's triggered ability and put it onto the stack. (603.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nathan activates Memnarch to gain control of Aspen's Instrument of the Bards in response to its first triggered ability in Aspen's upkeep. What will happen when the trigger resolves?
Aspen can choose to put a counter on Nathan's Instrument of the Bards. (603.3a) Gaining control of Instrument of the Bards does not change the controller of the trigger on the stack. (113.7a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Angelique controls Onakke Ogre and a token that's a copy of Bridge from Below. They cast Planar Cleansing. Do they create a Zombie token?
No. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the state of the game immediately before the event in question. (603.10a) Bridge from Below was on the battlefield at that time, and won't trigger.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nico casts Mortify targeting Alexandria's Caelorna, Coral Tyrant. Alexandria uses Redirect to change the target to Alexandria's Tyranid Harridan. Will its ward ability trigger?
Yes. Ward triggers whenever the permanent with the ability becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls. (702.21a) It doesn't matter who chose its target.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ashley controls Dralnu, Lich Lord, Furnace of Rath and six Swamps. Norah casts Lightning Helix targeting Dralnu, Lich Lord. If Ashley chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath, how many other permanents will they need to sacrifice?

Two or five, Ashley's choice.

Both Dralnu, Lich Lord and Furnace of Rath have replacement effects that modify how the game handles damage that is being dealt to Dralnu, Lich Lord. (614.1a) As Ashley is the controller of the affected object, Ashley will choose which order to apply the replacement effects in. (616.1) If Ashley chooses to apply Dralnu, Lich Lord's effect first, the 3 damage will be converted into sacrificing three permanents, and Furnace of Rath will no longer apply to that event since there's no longer any damage being dealt. If they chooses to apply Furnace of Rath first, then the three damage will be doubled to six damage, and then will be replaced by sacrificing six permanents.

Whether Ashley chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath or not is irrelevant, as all replacement effects are applied to the event before anything is actually sacrificed.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ariel controls Enduring Vitality and Naomi controls Verity Circle and Elephant Grass. Ariel attacks Naomi with Enduring Vitality, and then taps it to pay for the cost required by Elephant Grass. Will Naomi's Verity Circle trigger?

No. Verity Circle triggers only if the creature being tapped is not being declared as an attacker. Declaring an attacker is a multi-step process (508.1), some of which involve determining costs (508.1h), activating mana abilities (508.1i), and paying for costs. (508.1j) Therefore, tapping Enduring Vitality to pay for the cost required by Elephant Grass is part of declaring it as an attacker.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alex casts Volrath's Shapeshifter and has Magus of the Disk as the top card of their graveyard. How does it enter the battlefield?

Volrath's Shapeshifter will enter tapped. When determining how Volrath's Shapeshifter will enter the battlefield, the game looks ahead to see what Volrath's Shapeshifter looks like when it's on the battlefield, taking into account continuous effects from the permanents own static abilities that would apply to it once it's on the battlefield. (614.12) When Volrath's Shapeshifter is on the battlefield, it will have the replacement effect of "enters the battlefield tapped" and will enter tapped.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Avalyn activates Grindstone targeting Nathaniel. In response they activate Goblin Welder, sacrificing Grindstone to return Painter's Servant to the battlefield. They choose "black" as the color for Painter's Servant, and still in response to the Grindstone ability, Nathaniel casts Veil of Summer. What happens?

Grindstone's ability will still resolve and mill Nathaniel's library. Hexproof from black cares about color of the source of the ability (702.11d), and since Grindstone isn't on the battlefield anymore, the game uses its last-known information to check the legality of the ability's target. (608.2b) Since it was colorless when it was last on the battlefield, hexproof from black doesn't affect it.

(The game doesn't care about its color in the graveyard because it's a new object there and has no relation to the permanent as it existed on the battlefield. (400.7))
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aspen controls Woodland Chasm, two Islands, Snow-Covered Mountain, and Wastes. They cast Exotic Disease. What is the value of X?

4. Subtypes are listed on the type line of the card after a long dash (205.3b), so Snow-Covered Mountain has a basic land type of "Mountain" and Wastes has no basic land types. "Snow" is a supertype, not a type. (205.4a) Exotic Disease is looking for the number of distinct subtypes among all permanents Aspen controls, regardless of how many permanents those subtypes are on.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Armando casts Plumb the Forbidden, sacrificing a creature. Nico cast Reject Imperfection targeting Plumb the Forbidden. Will Armando still get a copy of Plumb the Forbidden?

Yes. Plumb the Forbidden has a triggered ability that triggers when Armando sacrifices creatures to pay for its additional cost. (603.1) This ability triggers while Armando is casting the spell (603.2, 603.2a), and is put on the stack above the spell as soon as they are done casting it and before they would get priority again. (603.3) This ability on the stack is independent of the original Plumb the Forbidden, and will resolve even if the original spell is countered. (113.7, 113.7a) It uses the last-known information of the spell on the stack in order to make the copy. (608.2h)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Andres casts Neverending Torment and uses Twincast to copy it once. How many copies of Neverending Torment will be created during their upkeep?

Two. Twincast will copy the full rules text of Neverending Torment, including its epic ability. (707.2) Upon resolution, both copies create delayed triggers that will trigger at the beginning of Andres's upkeep. (702.50a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Arianna controls Humility and casts a Phyrexian Metamorph. Can Arianna have it copy a creature as it enters the battlefield?
No. The game takes into account continuous effects already on the battlefield when determining how a permanent enters the battlefield. (614.12)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ariel has controlled Knight Errant enchanted with Everflame Eidolon since their last turn. Nyla casts Unfortunate Accident targeting Knight Errant. After Unfortunate Accident resolves and Knight Errant is put into Ariel's graveyard, can Ariel attack with Everflame Eidolon?
Yes. Ariel has controlled Everflame Eidolon continuously since their most recent turn began, so it can attack. (508.1a/302.6)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Does Muraganda Petroglyphs count Shepherd of the Flock as having no abilities?
Yes. The Adventurer portion of Shepherd of the Flock is an alternative set of characteristics that are not relevant while it's on the battlefield. They aren't abilities. (715.2, 715.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alfredo attacks with Trained Cheetah. Nataly declares no blocks and then casts Curtain of Light targeting Trained Cheetah. Does Trained Cheetah trigger?
Yes. "Blocked" in this context refers to the state of being a blocked creature. Trained Cheetah went from being an unblocked creature to being a blocked creature, so it "became blocked". (509.3c)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Azaria controls a Caged Sun (naming "green") that is a 2/2 Artifact Land Creature - Forest Saproling due to Life and Limb, March of the Machines, and Arcane Adaptation (*naming "Saproling"). Azaria taps the Caged Sun for {G}. What happens?

When the ability resolves, that is a land causing Azaria to add one or more mana of the chosen color, so Caged Sun's triggered ability triggers. When that trigger resolves, it is also a land causing Azaria to add one or more mana of the chosen color, so it triggers again. The triggered ability is a mana ability (605.1b), so players do not receive priority in between when it triggers and when it resolves. If the loop is not broken, the game is a draw. (104.4b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aiyana is at 2 life. Nathaniel controls Platinum Angel and is at -1 life. Aiyana casts Char, targeting the Platinum Angel. What happens when Char resolves?

Aiyana loses the game. Char deals 4 damage to Platinum Angel and 2 damage to Aiyana, then state-based actions are checked. (704.3) Platinum Angel has lethal damage marked on it and Aiyana has 0 life, so two state-based actions occur at the same time and Aiyana loses the game at the same time that Platinum Angel is destroyed. (704.5a, 704.5g)

Nathaniel would have lost the game during the next SBA check, but that doesn't matter, because the game already ended before the second check could happen. (104.1)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alberto has 1 life and controls Mana Confluence. Can they cast Angel's Grace without losing the game? If so, what will their resulting life total be?

No, Alberto would lose the game. Mana Confluence pays the life as a cost to activate the ability. If Alberto taps Mana Confluence before casting Angel's Grace, they'll die before they can begin to cast Angel's Grace. If they begin casting Angel's Grace and activate Mana Confluence while casting the spell, they'll lose the game when state-based actions are checked after they're done casting Angel's Grace, before it resolves. (702.61a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Alex controls Skrelv's Hive and five 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block." Nicholas currently has no poison counters. They attack Nicholas with all five Phyrexian Mites. Will Alex gain 5 life?

No. Toxic causes Nicholas to gain poison counters when combat damage is dealt. ([702.164c], [120.3g]) Therefore they won't have any poison counters at the time the Mites deal damage and the Mites will not have lifelink.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ainsley controls Bolas's Citadel and has Lovestruck Beast on top of their library. Can they cast Heart's Desire? If so, how much life do they pay?

Yes and it will cost Ainsley 1 life. As part of putting Lovestruck Beast on the stack Ainsley chooses whether or not they want to cast the Adventure or not. (715.3) If they casts Heart's Desire they will need to pay life equal to the mana value of the spell they are casting, which in this case is one. (715.3b)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn activates the Unearth ability of their Scourge Devil, returning it to the battlefield. Before their end step, Autumn casts Reality Ripple targeting Scourge Devil. What happens to it?

Scourge Devil phases out. When the unearth trigger resolves during Autumn's end step, it won't be exiled. (702.26b) It will phase back in during Autumn's next untap step (502.1/702.26a), after which point it will be exiled instead of being put anywhere else if it would leave the battlefield. (702.84a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn plays Castle Locthwain as their first land, opponent controls Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. Does the it enter the battlefield untapped?

No. When determining how to apply replacement effects for a permanent entering the battlefield, the game takes into account effects that would apply to it on the battlefield and what it would look like on the battlefield, but it doesn't see itself on the battlefield in any way. (614.12)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Alicia controls Angrath's Marauders and casts their last card, Flame Spill, targeting a 1/1 creature that Nico controls. How much damage will Nico take?

Six. First Alicia will allocate one damage to the token and three to Nico. (120.4a) Angrath's Marauders's replacement effect will then double the three damage being dealt to Nico to six. (120.4b, 614.1a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari has Empty-Shrine Kannushi in their graveyard, and controls Cairn Wanderer. Does Cairn Wanderer have protection from black?

No. Empty-Shrine Kannushi doesn't have protection, it has an ability that grants it protection. (113.1a, 113.10) That ability only functions on the battlefield (113.6), so it does not have protection in the graveyard.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Ari controls Volrath's Shapeshifter and the top card of their graveyard is Syr Konrad, the Grim. They cast Resurrection targeting Syr Konrad, the Grim. When everything resolves, how many damage is Nehemiah dealt?

1. Abilities that trigger when a card leaves a graveyard check the game state immediately before the event happened to see if they trigger. (603.10, 603.10a) At that point, Volrath's Shapeshifter still has all abilities of Syr Konrad, the Grim, so it will trigger, dealing 1 to Nehemiah. On the other hand, Syr Konrad, the Grim is still in the graveyard, so its ability does not trigger.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Nathaniel controls Lion's Eye Diamond. Ainsley casts Take Possession targeting the Lion's Eye Diamond. Can Nathaniel activate it in response?

Yes. Lion's Eye Diamond's ability is a mana ability. (605.1a) Split second does not prevent mana abilities from being activated. (702.61a) "Activate only as an instant" simply means that Nathaniel must have priority, not that Nathaniel could actually cast an instant at that time. (304.5)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Asher controls Doubling Season and activates the +2 ability of Arlinn, the Moon's Fury. How many loyalty counters are put on Arlinn, the Moon's Fury?

Just 2 loyalty counters. Doubling Season only cares about counters being placed by effects, not costs. Since the counters put on Arlinn, the Moon's Fury are part of its activation cost, Doubling Season will not affect them. (609.1, 606.4)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Autumn controls Magus of the Moon and Sheltered Valley. Nia casts Gift of Tusks targeting Magus of the Moon. After Gift of Tusks has resolved, what are the characteristics of Sheltered Valley?

A Land - Mountain that can tap for {R} and no other types of mana. It's still named "Sheltered Valley". (305.7) Magus of the Moon's ability applies in the type changing layer, layer 4. (613.1d) It doesn't lose that ability until layer 6 (613.1f), at which point the ability has already been applied.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Brayden controls Pandemonium. Avery casts Wu Infantry and targets Brayden's Runeclaw Bear with the Pandemonium trigger. In response Carmen casts Fiery Temper targeting Avery causing them to lose the game. Will Brayden's creature die?

The triggered ability of Pandemonium includes a choice to be made upon resolution. (608.2d) However the player that is supposed to make that choice is no longer in the game, therefore the controller of the trigger chooses another player to make that choice. (800.4g) In this case Brayden will choose another player to decide whether Pandemonium's trigger will deal damage to Runeclaw Bear. Brayden is the controller of the trigger since they control the enchantment that generated the trigger, even though Avery is the player making choices about the trigger. (603.3a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Ari controls Case of the Ransacked Lab and casts Call of the Herd for its Flashback cost. Will Case of the Ransacked Lab decrease the cost they have to pay?

Yes. Flashback is an alternative cost to cast a spell. (702.34a) When casting Call of the Herd, Ari will first determine the base cost, which in this case is the flashback cost. After that, they will apply all cost increases and reductions. (601.2f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aubrey controls Stone Haven Outfitter and Wandering Ones. Aubrey activates Skullclamp's equip ability targeting Wandering Ones. What happens when the equip ability resolves?
After Skullclamp's equip ability resolves, the game checks state-based actions. (117.5/704.3) At that point Wandering Ones is getting +1/+1 and does not die. (704.5f)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Addison controls Besotted Knight which is enchanted with Spirit Shackle and has a +0/+2 counter on it. Addison attacks with Besotted Knight. After the combat phase has ended, what counters are on Besotted Knight?
A +0/+2 counter and a -0/-2 counter. The rule that causes +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters to cancel out only refers to those specific types of counters and not any other type of counter. (122.3)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Which of the following cards have one or more mana abilities?

Soulbright Flamekin, Deranged Assistant, Chromatic Sphere, Keeper of Progenitus, Sarkhan, Fireblood, Sakiko, Mother of Summer, Everflowing Chalice, Inner Fire, Charmed Pendant, Forbidden Orchard, Spectral Searchlight

Deranged Assistant, Chromatic Sphere, Keeper of Progenitus, Everflowing Chalice, Charmed Pendant, Forbidden Orchard, and Spectral Searchlight. (605.1a, 605.1b)

Triggered abilities are only mana abilities if they trigger from the activation or resolution of an activated mana ability, or from mana being added to a player's mana pool. (605.1b)

It doesn't matter if the ability won't produce mana on a specific game state (605.2) or has other effects or timing restrictions.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
What layer does Myrel, Shield of Argive's "During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells or activate abilities of artifacts, creatures, or enchantments." ability apply in?

Because Myrel, Shield of Argive's ability doesn't change the characteristics of any objects, it doesn't apply in any layer. (613.1) Instead it's a static ability that generates a continuous effect that modifies the rules of the game. (611.1, 611.3)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.

Nathanael controls City of Traitors and Terrian, World Tyrant. Aubrey casts Path to Exile targeting Terrian, World Tyrant and Nathanael finds a basic land. Does City of Traitors need to be sacrificed?
No. "Playing a land" is a special action (305.1), and not the same as putting a land onto the battlefield as part of resolving a spell or ability. (305.4/701.18a)
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Abraham casts Time Stretch. Can they choose to skip both extra turns with Time Vault?

Yes. As their turn ends, they can apply Time Vault's replacement effect, which means the next turn gets skipped and Time Vault gets untapped as part of the next turn that actually happens. (614.10/614.1b, 614.10b) Then, since it's still tapped as Abraham's turn is ending, they can choose to skip the next turn again.
You are a Magic: The Gathering rules expert. Answer precisely and cite comprehensive rule numbers.
Aaden controls Lore Drakkis mutated on top of Elvish Clancaller. They activate the ability of the merged permanent. Can they get a Lore Drakkis from their library?
